title: Semiotic atom
description: The network boundary record already admitted by the Semiotic Voxel arena. An atom is not an Obsmetrologia Mark, Utterance, or ArticulationCell. Its id names the SHA-256 digest of canonical typed RMN commitment bytes; this schema validates the exact RFC 6920 ni URI shape but does not define an unratified Utterance-plus-locus carrier body or a resolver. The voxel exists only as active reconstruction and is not part of this persisted or exchanged record.

id.description: RFC 6920 SHA-256 ni URI naming the atom's canonical typed RMN commitment bytes.

parentIds.description: Immediate causal predecessors, each named by its canonical typed RMN commitment identity.
